digest.component_or_area: Jira reconciler bridge / comment-echo history reclamation
propositions: Six rollout-created duplicate comments remain in live Jira and reachable tickets history after reconciler fixes stopped the echo loop
Targeted deletion of six specific Jira comment IDs (997143, 997144, 997145, 997255, 997256, 997293) must occur during a controlled quiet window while writers are stopped and origin/tickets is frozen
Git history must be rewritten to remove echo material using prepare/manifest/reclaim scripts, with exact-lease publication to prevent ref movement and stale union artifacts

Post-deletion but pre-publication state creates a quarantined interval where Jira lacks six IDs while old tickets still records them; failure must preserve evidence and allow forward correction without Git rollback
All 1,520 removed comment path aliases and six deleted Jira IDs must remain absent after service restoration while six survivor IDs remain present with unchanged non-target comment bytes
